bullish.title: Pattern Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner for the Fifth Consecutive Year
bullish.reason: Pattern Group Inc. (Nasdaq: PTRN) 連續 5 年獲得 Inc. Power Partner 獎項，此獎項肯定了公司在商業合作與服務交付上的穩定表現，有助於提升品牌信譽與客戶信任度，對股價有正面但溫和的影響。
